events.title: Advanced Access Drops
events.summary: Earn the first global launch rewards by watching participating AION 2 streams.
events.timing_note: The published Pacific watch window is September 30–October 4. Its closing time falls on October 5 in Central time.
events.participation: Watch streams with this campaign enabled, track progress in Twitch Drops, and claim each earned reward. Follow the official guide to connect the correct Steam or NC account.

events.title: War for Atreia · Series 1
events.summary: A separate Drops track available through the event’s participating creators.
events.participation: Watch a participating War for Atreia creator. Other AION 2 streams do not earn this campaign’s rewards.

events.title: Global Launch Drops
events.summary: The active global campaign includes the Head Bow and Adorable Young Elim shoulder cosmetic.
events.timing_note: Twitch lists this campaign as open, checked October 8, with a watch window of October 5 at 8:00 AM through October 17 at 1:59 AM Central. NC's original Pacific and European opening dates disagree; the precise opening shown here follows the individual Twitch campaign. Claim earned rewards in Twitch Inventory by October 31 at 1:59 AM Central.
events.participation: Use the participating live-channel link in Twitch's Global Launch Celebration campaign. Confirm your progress is counting and claim each earned reward in Twitch Inventory. Rewards can only be earned on one stream at a time.

events.title: War for Atreia · Series 2
events.summary: The second creator campaign features Pet: Two after four hours of eligible viewing.
events.timing_note: Twitch lists Series 2 as open, checked October 8, and confirms NC's watch window: October 7 at noon through October 10 at 1:59 AM Central. The separate Twitch Inventory claim deadline is October 31 at 1:59 AM Central.
events.participation: Watch a participating live creator listed in Twitch's War for Atreia Series 2 campaign. Confirm your progress is counting and claim each earned reward in Twitch Inventory. Other AION 2 streams do not earn this campaign's rewards.

events.title: War for Atreia · Series 3
events.summary: The active final creator campaign includes the Leather Crop Fit outfit after four hours of eligible viewing.
events.timing_note: Twitch lists Series 3 as open, checked October 12, with a watch window of October 12 at noon through October 15 at 1:59 AM Central. NC's original notice still says exact times are TBD and describes creator unlock conditions; use the participating creators in Twitch's individual campaign. Claim earned rewards in Twitch Inventory by October 31 at 1:59 AM Central.
events.participation: Watch a participating live creator listed in Twitch's War for Atreia Series 3 campaign. Confirm your progress is counting and claim each earned reward in Twitch Inventory. Other AION 2 streams do not earn this campaign's rewards.

events.title: Daeva Makeover
events.summary: Show your character design in the official community character creation event.
events.timing_note: Submission dates are published; exact opening and closing times are not specified.
events.participation: Submit two forward-facing Closet screenshots, one headshot and one full body, in the official AION 2 Discord event channel. Include your region, server and character name. The official announcement links to the submission channel.

events.title: Guides for Glory
events.summary: Share an original guide to help other Daevas find their way through AION 2 Global.
events.timing_note: Submission dates only; exact opening and closing times are not specified.
rewards: Official guide feature and Tutor of Atreia Discord title
events.participation: Post your original guide in the official community events channel, with your region, server and character name. Guides made before September 30 are not eligible. Follow the submission link in the official announcement.

events.title: Transcendence · Early Access servers
events.summary: Climb your server and class leaderboard in Deus Research Base and Shattered Arkanis.
events.timing_note: Early Access servers begin September 30. Exact opening and closing times are not specified.
events.participation: Complete the participating Transcendence dungeons to earn Rank Points. Check ESC → Transcendence → Rank → Class. Rankings are separate for each server and class.

events.title: Transcendence · Launch servers
events.summary: The same dungeon leaderboard competition opens with global launch on the other servers.
events.timing_note: For servers outside Early Access. Exact opening and closing times are not specified.
events.participation: Earn Rank Points in Deus Research Base and Shattered Arkanis. Find your server and class ranking at ESC → Transcendence → Rank → Class.

events.title: Beauty of Atreia
events.summary: A screenshot celebration of Atreia’s world, characters and pets, followed by a community vote.
events.timing_note: Published dates only. Each theme has its own submission window; the final week is voting.
rewards: Weekly top picks: 2 Shop Tokens and 7 Dye Tokens
events.participation: Post a screenshot matching the current theme in the official AION 2 Discord event channel, or on X/Instagram with #BeautyOfAtreia. Include your region, server and character name.

events.title: Launch attendance rewards
events.summary: Collect growth items through the 7-day Shugo and 14-day Daily Attendance logs highlighted in the global launch notice.
events.timing_note: Both logs close December 15 at 10:30 PM PST (December 16 at 12:30 AM Central). Daily reset is 11:00 PM Pacific, or 1:00 AM the following day in Central time. No separate later claim deadline is published.
rewards: 7-day Shugo log: Kina, Soul Crystals, Centuryroot Tokens, Phantasmal Fragments and Abyss Points; day 7 grants 1,000,000 Kina
14-day Daily log: Life Crystals, Battle Enhance Scrolls, Resurrection Spiritstones, Hidden Cube keys, Skin Chests, Unknown Fissure Challenge Tickets and Odyle Energy
events.participation: Log in and open the in-game Attendance menu to claim each day's reward. Attendance rewards can be claimed once per server, arrive immediately in inventory and cannot be traded. See the official tables for daily quantities.

events.title: Launch login rewards
events.summary: Pre-registration and Steam Wishlist rewards are available to every player who creates an account and logs in during the reward period.
events.timing_note: Log in before the December 1 maintenance cutoff in Pacific time (December 2 in Central). Collect the mailed rewards before the separate mail expiry.
rewards: Pet: Pagati plus a choice of one additional pet
Wishlist chest of potions, scrolls and Resurrection Spiritstones
events.participation: Create an account and log in before the cutoff. Rewards arrive automatically by in-game mail; collect them before that mail expires.

events.title: Trick or Treat · Halloween
events.summary: Collect Pumpkin Coins through attendance and event missions, exchange them for Halloween gifts, and craft Candy Keys with dungeon fragments.
events.timing_note: Scheduled after October 13 maintenance through before November 3 maintenance in the published Pacific dates; the European dates are October 14–November 4. Exact event opening and closing times are not announced. Item removal times below are separate from the event window.
rewards: 250 Pumpkin Coins: Special Halloween Chest containing the Spooky Scary Skeleton breastplate skin and 10,000 Pet Soul Crystals; level 10+, once per server
Coin shop: Skin Chests, Resurrection Spiritstones and dungeon tickets; Odyle Energy and Lower Abyss Rift Stones require level 45
Candy rewards include Growth Pet Chests, Abyss Points, Odyle Energy and consumables
events.participation: Claim the 14-day Trick or Treat log in Attendance and complete Season Mission > Event tasks for Pumpkin Coins. Exchange coins at Coin Merchants in Dawn Legion Base or Zumion Village (Elyos), or Safe Haven or Nornir Assembly (Asmodian). Complete Expedition and Transcendence dungeons for Candy Key Fragments; use Event Substance Morphs to craft keys and open town candies.
details: Attendance rewards are once per server; days 7 and 14 grant 100 coins each, other days 35. Event missions reset weekly per server.
Each red, yellow or blue Candy Key costs 60 fragments, with one craft of each color per server per week.
Spend event coins before the event closes; the notice says mission rewards are removed after the event period. Rewards arrive immediately in inventory and cannot be traded.
Halloween Candy, Cookies, Candy Key Fragments and Candy Keys are deleted November 4 at 1:00 AM Central. This is an item-removal time, not a confirmed event cutoff.

The Special Halloween Chest and the listed expiring Spiritstones, dungeon tickets, Shugo Festival Reward Keys and Odyle Energy are deleted December 16 at 1:00 AM Central. Open or use them before removal; this does not extend event participation.

events.title: Conquerors of the Abyss
events.summary: Level 45+ characters can buy extra Lower Abyss time with Kina during the scheduled event.
events.timing_note: Event purchases end when scheduled maintenance begins October 27 at 11:30 PM PDT, which is October 28 at 1:30 AM CDT in Chicago. This anchors the event notice's before-maintenance closing date; the published October 13-27 Pacific / October 14-28 European date ranges remain unchanged. The opening time is unconfirmed. Each purchased stone expires seven days after acquisition. Maintenance timing is subject to official changes.
rewards: Lower Abyss Rift Stone (7 Days) (Bound): 50,000 Kina each
Each stone restores one hour of Lower Abyss usage time; limit seven per character per week
events.participation: At character level 45 or higher, open Shop > Wind Breeze Merchants > Special and purchase the event stones with Kina. Use each stone within seven days of receipt, before it is automatically deleted. Items arrive immediately in inventory and cannot be traded.
details: The exact purchase cutoff follows the official October 27/28 maintenance notice. Stone expiry is individual and does not extend event purchases.

events.title: Rise to the Challenge
events.summary: Buy weekly Resurrection Spiritstone bundles with Kina to support dungeon challenges.
events.timing_note: The event notice schedules opening after October 20 maintenance in Pacific time, while the patch notes list October 21. European dates are October 21–December 16. Purchases end before December 15 maintenance in Pacific time. Exact event times and opening confirmation are not published; the conflicting opening dates remain unresolved. Item removal is a separate deadline.
rewards: Step 2: 30 more Resurrection Spiritstones (Season 1) for 50,000 Kina; weekly limits apply per server
events.participation: During the published window, open Shop > Wind Breeze Merchants. Reach the Step 1 purchase limit to unlock Step 2. Rewards arrive immediately in inventory and cannot be traded. Time-limited Season 1 stones are consumed before permanent bound stones.
details: The event's expiring Resurrection Spiritstones are removed December 16 at 2:00 AM Central (00:00 PST / 09:00 CET). Use them before removal; this is not the event purchase cutoff or a later claim window.

The event notice labels the included items Resurrection Spiritstone (Bound), while the patch notes use Resurrection Spiritstone (Season 1). The notice separately identifies existing permanent bound stones; the event expiry does not imply those permanent stones expire.

events.title: AION 2 graphics card giveaway
events.summary: Enter the official launch giveaway for a chance to win one NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080.
events.timing_note: The published Pacific window is October 5–12, ending October 12 at 11:59 PM PDT (October 13 at 1:59 AM Central). No exact opening time or separate prize-claim deadline is published.
rewards: One NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080 graphics card for the giveaway winner
events.participation: Use the Gleam Giveaway link in the official notice and complete at least one listed entry action. Playing AION 2 on Steam for one hour awards 10 entries; official community follow/join actions are also listed. NC lists residents of the United States, Canada and Europe as eligible, excluding Belgium, Netherlands, Serbia, Slovakia, Italy and Portugal. Check the full entry rules on the giveaway page.

events.title: Ludra Conquest Check-In
events.summary: Check in on seven days during the two-week event to earn growth rewards and the Lush Leaf Tiara.
events.timing_note: Scheduled November 4 at 8:00 AM through November 18 at 1:59 AM Central (November 4, 06:00–November 17, 23:59 PST). These are published future times, not confirmation that the event is open.
events.participation: Log in and check in once per day during the event. Each check-in unlocks the next reward; seven check-ins complete the track during the 14-day window.

events.title: Odyle Energy Boost
events.summary: Log in daily for four Odyle Energy delivered once per account through in-game mail.
events.timing_note: The notice schedules October 28 after maintenance through November 10 before maintenance in its Pacific column; the European closing date is November 11. The opening follows maintenance; its completion and the closing maintenance time are not confirmed. Each mail expires seven days after receipt, so there is no single confirmed claim deadline.
rewards: 4 Odyle Energy per account per day
events.participation: Log in once per day during the scheduled event, open in-game mail and claim four Odyle Energy. Delivery is limited to once per account per day. Collect each mail within seven days of receiving it.

events.title: Ludra Twitch Drops
events.summary: A scheduled 14-hour reward track includes Dotted Glasses and the Black Conical Hat.
events.timing_note: Scheduled November 4 at 8:00 AM through November 18 at 1:59 AM Central (November 4, 06:00–November 17, 23:59 PST). These are published future times, not confirmation that the event is open. Campaign activation and participating channels are not yet verified. No separate Twitch Inventory claim deadline is published; the October 31 deadline for earlier launch campaigns does not apply to this campaign.
rewards: 10 hr: 1 Content Usage Ticket Selection Chest (Bound)
events.participation: When the published watch window begins, find this campaign in Twitch Drops and use its participating-channel link. Confirm the campaign is enabled and progress is counting, then claim each earned reward in Twitch Inventory. A later claim cutoff has not been announced.

events.title: Ludra Hunt
events.summary: Earn regional first-clear titles or the Ludra Hunter title by defeating the returning raid during the event.
events.timing_note: Scheduled November 4 after maintenance through November 24 before maintenance in Pacific time; the European closing date is November 25. Exact raid/event opening and closing times are not announced. The separate check-in and Drops opening time is not a confirmed raid opening time.
rewards: First hard-mode party per region: Conqueror of Ludra
Hard-mode parties 2–5 per region: Champion of Ludra
Hard-mode parties 6–20 per region: Challenger of Ludra
All other players clearing normal or hard mode: Ludra Hunter
events.participation: Prepare item level 2,800 for normal mode or 3,000 for hard mode. Defeat Ludra during the scheduled event; the first 20 hard-mode parties in each region qualify for ranked titles. NA East and NA West are separate eligible regions.
details: Ranked titles have a purple decorative effect. Clears outside the event period do not qualify.
NC says titles will be sent no later than December 3 at 1:59 AM Central (December 2, 23:59 PST). This is a delivery deadline, not an extended clear or claim window.

events.title: Ludra Outfit Contest
events.summary: Create a Ludra-inspired outfit and submit one unedited in-game screenshot to the official Discord contest.
events.timing_note: Scheduled November 4 at 8:00 AM through November 18 at 1:59 AM Central (November 4, 06:00–November 17, 23:59 PST). These are published future times, not confirmation that the event is open.
events.participation: Eligible regions: Europe, NA East, NA West and South America. Submit one in-game screenshot per player in the official AION 2 Discord event submission area. Include region, server and character name. Editing and AI images are not allowed. Use outfit combinations, dyes and the environment to represent Ludra.
details: Community managers select the top three for originality and creativity; Discord upvotes select Community's Choice. No duplicate winners.
NC says prizes will be mailed by November 26 at 1:59 AM Central (November 25, 23:59 PST); this is a reward-delivery deadline, not the submission cutoff.

events.title: Daeva Bootcamp
events.summary: Clear eligible dungeons toward shared milestones that unlock mailed rewards for all Global players.
events.timing_note: Scheduled November 4 at 8:00 AM through November 18 at 1:59 AM Central (November 4, 06:00–November 17, 23:59 PST). These are published future times, not confirmation that the event is open.
rewards: 500,000 clears: 2 Instant Clear Tickets, 1 Intermediate Training Arcana, 5 Resurrection Stones
1,250,000 clears: 2 Instant Clear Tickets, 1 Intermediate Training Arcana, 5 Resurrection Stones
3,000,000 clears: 2 Instant Clear Tickets, 2 Intermediate Training Arcana, 5 Resurrection Stones
5,000,000 clears: 3 Instant Clear Tickets, 2 Intermediate Training Arcana, 10 Resurrection Stones
7,000,000 clears: 5 Instant Clear Tickets, 3 Intermediate Training Arcana, 10 Resurrection Stones
events.participation: Clear Conquest (Normal/Hard): Krao Cave, Draupnir, Urugugu Canyon or Vakron Sky Island; or Transcendence (all stages): Shattered Arkanis or Deus Research Base. Europe, NA East, NA West, South America and Asia contribute. Collect milestone rewards from in-game account mail.
details: Rewards are sent as milestones are reached and no later than November 19 at 1:59 AM Central (November 18, 23:59 PST). This is a delivery deadline; no separate mail-expiry deadline is published.
